digest.component_or_area: cross-ticket overlap detection and enrichment drain subsystem
propositions: The overlap detector implementation (2,280 LOC across enrich.py, enrich_drain.py, overlap/*.py modules and CLI) is removed entirely due to write-path starvation caused by 4+ commits per ticket on the shared branch.

The four event-type names (TICKET_DIGEST, ENQUEUE_ENRICH, CLAIM_ENRICH, DONE_ENRICH) are retained in _NON_REPLAY_KNOWN_TYPES and EVENT_TYPES with 'retired producer' comments so ~105k historical events continue to parse without tombstones.
The create-time duplicate journal (recent_creates.py) is re-enabled by flipping suggest_duplicate_tickets to true in rebar.toml, independent of the deleted enrichment queue.

All 2,280 LOC of overlap implementation, 13 config keys, 13 env vars, one CLI verb, two prompts, two schemas, and supporting test fixtures/tests are deleted; kept files are edited to remove only the call sites and registrations.
Historical compact/fsck behavior for the four retired event types is preserved; new regression test verifies they still parse, survive compaction, and pass fsck.
A leftover [llm] overlap_* config key is silently ignored under the reserved [llm] section and does not interfere with `REBAR_CONFIG_UNKNOWN_KEYS=error`.
